issues.desc: background.md (Key Insights paragraph, twice) and checklist CHK-001 context reference the term "recursive tsc gate" without an inline one-line definition in the document itself; the term is only fully explained in CLAUDE.md's separate pre-push-hook-plus-recursive-tsc-gate section. A reader relying solely on this story's own files (background.md/checklist.json) without cross-referencing CLAUDE.md would not immediately know this refers to validate --lint and .githooks/pre-push both recursively running tsc --noEmit over every tsconfig.json in the repo. Not blocking since CLAUDE.md is required baseline reading for this project, but worth a one-clause parenthetical for standalone readability.
